observations: Photo 0 shows a black 3-piece speaker system with a central subwoofer and two satellite speakers, all with orange accents on the speaker cones.
The central unit has a digital display showing 'RUSH 0' in red, and buttons labeled F, VOL+, VOL-, +/-, and others.
Photo 1 shows the same system from a slightly different angle, with the LG logo visible on the front of the subwoofer.
The system is placed on a marbled surface, and a black cable is visible on the left side.
The seller's watermark 'RIVERS SPORTS PORT' is overlaid on both photos.

claims.evidence: The term 'advanced eq' and 'bass blast+' are subjective marketing claims not verifiable from photos alone.

claims.claim: deeper bass and clearer vocals are made possible with bass...
claims.evidence: Subjective marketing claim; cannot be verified from photos.

claims.claim: All keys and buttons working, adapter included. Bought from the UK, no dead key, no crackle.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The system may not be functional (e.g., speakers not working, subwoofer not powered, or internal damage).
risks.proof: A video showing the system powered on, playing audio, and all speakers responding to volume and buttons.

risks.risk: The subwoofer or satellite speakers may have internal damage or be missing parts (e.g., drivers, wiring).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the speaker cones, drivers, and internal components (if possible) or a video of the system playing audio.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially damaged or incomplete

risks.risk: The system may be missing accessories (e.g., remote, power adapter, or cables).
risks.proof: Photo showing all included accessories laid out next to the system.

proof_requests: Video of the system powered on and playing audio from multiple speakers.
Close-up photos of the speaker cones, drivers, and internal components.
Photo showing all included accessories (remote, power adapter, cables, etc.).
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
